name: Saint and Saviour
source:
In a dukedom and country where magic is valued like nothing else, being born with no magic capabilities makes Loriena a prime target of criticsm from society, and family, in turn.

Now, having failed to become a saint, all she could become was the Queen to earn even a shred of respect.

Growing up loveless, Loriena coped unhealthily. Her diary contains everything from when she was 15 to 18, but it isn't nearly enough to know what darkness is imbued in her daily life.

You've somehow woken up as 16 year old Loriena.

Maybe, you think, this could be your chance for freedom. By using this knowledge of the future, maybe you could save yourself from the hell that Loriena went through.

[From [url=https://eirdonne.itch.io/saint-and-saviour]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个对魔法视若无睹的公国和国家里，天生没有魔法能力的洛莉娜反过来又成为社会和家庭批评的首要目标。

如今，成不了圣人，她只能成为女王，赢得一丝尊重。

洛瑞娜在没有爱的环境中长大，她的应对方式并不健康。她的日记包含了她从15岁到18岁的一切，但这还不足以了解她日常生活中的黑暗。

不知怎的，你一觉醒来就变成了16岁的洛瑞娜。

也许，你想，这可能是你获得自由的机会。通过利用这些关于未来的知识，也许你可以把自己从洛瑞娜所经历的地狱中拯救出来。

[来自[url=https://eirdonne.itch.io/saint-and-saviour]Itch.io[/url]]
